'''Loposa''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] who served the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Galactic War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], when she was stationed on the [[Space station/Legends|space station]] [[Carrick Station]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Operations Gear Vendor for the [[Jedi Consular]] class, Master Loposa was first added to the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as part of Game Update 2.4 on [[October 1]], [[2013]], along with the other Operations Gear Vendors.<ref name="Patch">{{TORweb|url=patchnotes/2.4.0/dread-war|text=Game Update 2.4: The Dread War Patch Notes}}</ref> She was later removed in Game Update 5.0 on [[November 29]], [[2016]], which retired the PvP and PvE gear vendors in favor of the Command system.<ref name="5.0">{{TORweb|url=patchnotes/11292016/game-update-5.0-knights-eternal-throne-early-access|text=Game Update 5.0: Knights of the Eternal Throne Early Access Patch Notes}}</ref>
